title: Define the checked delivery contract
goal: Define how versioned results, evidence, independent review, acceptance, and confirmation form an accountable delivery contract.
scope: Specify immutable ResultVersion records and evidence bound to exact criteria, checks, sources, and environments.
Define independent review and AcceptanceAuthority decisions without treating agreement as confirmation.
Define the final report and how it preserves unmet criteria and uncertainty.
acceptance: The reviewed contract requires applicable new checks for changed result contents and prevents evidence reuse across versions.
Acceptance, independent review, and deterministic or external confirmation are distinct recorded facts.
The contract prevents applicable failures from being overridden by agent agreement or self-assessment.
The acceptance scenarios define honest rejected and accepted outcomes, including accepted-but-unconfirmed results, with criterion-level evidence.
context: This task is intentionally unscheduled until bounded native execution is implemented and accepted.

history.note: Clarified that acceptance and confirmation are independent; accepted results may remain unconfirmed.
